question: Seven boxes D, E, F, G, I, J and K are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order. Only four boxes are kept between E and D. Only F is kept above E. Only two boxes are kept between J and K. G is kept immediately above I. K is not kept immediately above G. Which box is kept fourth from the top?
solution:
Given: Seven boxes D, E, F, G, I, J and K are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
